title: ProtocolCanary-Fixtures Validator Report
description: Schema for the JSON report produced by `python3 tools/validate/validate.py --format json`.

status.description: Overall validation status: 'ok' if there are no errors, 'failed' otherwise.

roots.description: The root directories that were validated.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the validated root directory.

valid.description: Whether the root was a valid directory that could be scanned.

fixture_count.description: Number of .toml fixture files found under this root.

total_fixture_files.description: Total number of fixture files validated across all roots.

errors.description: Validation errors, if any. Empty when status is 'ok'.

path.description: Path to the file or directory that produced the error.

warnings.description: Validation warnings. May be present even when status is 'ok'.
